design: Hero (desktop/frame-00.png): drop the gradient text fill on the H1 and set it solid white, or move the headline onto a dark solid panel; the lavender-on-purple left half of the headline is the lowest-contrast element on the page.

Type: load one display family (a condensed or geometric sans) for H1 and H2 and keep Arial for body only, with a declared scale (e.g. 72 / 40 / 24 / 16 / 13); today every level is Arial bold at a size that drifts between sections.

Replace the emoji in all nine cards with one drawn icon set (single stroke weight, single colour from the palette) or with product screenshots; the three identical card rows should also differ in layout (e.g. the testimonials as a single wide quote, the features as an image-left list).
Give the purple a role: use it for the CTA and link states only, and drop the duplicate gradient band before the footer (desktop/frame-02.png) so the hero is the one gradient on the page.
usability: Nav on mobile (mobile/frame-00.png): collapse the five links into a menu button below 768 px, or wrap them to a second row; 'About' is clipped and 'Contact' is not reachable without horizontal scrolling.
Add a secondary action or an in-page anchor on the hero CTA ('Get Started Today' goes nowhere visible) so a visitor can reach Features or Pricing without the nav.
Make the nav links match the page sections or remove the ones with no target: Solutions, Pricing, About and Contact have no corresponding section in the outline.
Mark the footer text (about 13 px #999 on white, desktop/frame-02.png) up to 14 px and a darker grey so it clears the body contrast floor.
creativity: Pick one idea native to 'the future of work' and carry it through: for instance a live, editable task board as the hero image that the three feature sections zoom into on scroll.
Replace the three-equal-cards pattern with at least one section that is not a card grid (a full-width product frame, a numbered list, a single large quote).
If motion is added, add one considered reveal (a pinned hero or a staggered card entrance) rather than ambient effects; nothing in the render set shows any motion at all.
content: Replace the three Lorem ipsum paragraphs in Why Choose Us with one specific claim each (a latency number, a compliance standard, an integration count).

Rewrite the testimonials as two or three sentences from a named person at a named company with a role and an outcome, or remove the section until real quotes exist; 'Trusted by Thousands' needs a number or a logo row.
Add at least one real product image or screenshot per feature; the page has 0 images and the emoji carry all the imagery.
Rewrite the hero subheading to say what Nexora is (what kind of platform, for whom); 'unlock your potential' and 'cutting-edge' say nothing a competitor could not.
